disclaimer: High-level points + official URLs only. Not full treaty text.

items.title: SOLAS · Verified Gross Mass (VGM)
items.summary: Shipper must verify packed container gross mass and provide VGM before stowage. Method 1 = weigh sealed container; Method 2 = sum cargo+dunnage+tare (authorized). No VGM → no load (unless master/terminal obtain VGM another way).
items.summary_zh: 托运人负责验证装箱集装箱毛重并提前提供 VGM。方法1整箱称重；方法2累加。无 VGM 不得装船。

items.title: IMO/ILO/UNECE CTU Code
items.summary: Non-mandatory global code of practice for packing cargo transport units (suitability, securing, DG, training). Often referenced by national law. Not a port-specific stuffing ban list.
items.summary_zh: 非强制全球实践守则；可被国内法引用。覆盖适宜性、系固、危货、培训。不是港别摆法禁令表。

items.title: CSC · Safe Containers 1972
items.title_zh: CSC · 国际集装箱安全公约
items.summary: Structural safety; CSC Safety Approval Plate (max gross, stacking, ACEP). cargo + tare ≤ rated max gross.
items.summary_zh: 结构安全与 CSC 铭牌；货重+皮重不得超过铭牌最大营运总质量。

items.title: ISPM 15 · Wood packaging
items.summary: IPPC/FAO standard for wood packaging in international trade: debarked wood + approved treatment + ISPM 15 mark under NPPO authority.
items.summary_zh: 国际贸易木质包装：去皮 + 批准处理 + ISPM15 标识。

items.title: IMDG Code (DG · high level)
items.summary: Mandatory DG rules under SOLAS. 3D CargoPlan MVP: DG flag → port DG ops / segregation hooks only — not a full UN-number classifier.
items.summary_zh: SOLAS 下强制危货规则。MVP 只做危品标记→港口危货作业提示，不做完整 UN 编号引擎。
